summary_en: The video features vibrant lion and dragon dance performances on an outdoor stage at night. Performers in white lion costumes execute precise balancing and jumping acts across high metal pole structures, while musicians play drums and cymbals below. Additionally, the footage provides detailed close-ups of the colorful lion and dragon costumes and props.
